evals.prompt: /tk-github-image-upload-to-pr gh attach가 설치되어 있고 대상 repo write 권한도 있어. 현재 PR body의 ## 스크린샷 영역에 local.png를 넣어줘.
evals.expected_output: The skill uses gh attach without --comment, updates only the intended body section, and verifies the upload ref, source Markdown, rendered HTML, and asset link before passing.

evals.prompt: /tk-github-image-upload-to-pr gh-attach 설치는 거부하고 CDP를 선택할게. 이 PR comment에 이미 작성 중인 draft가 있어도 덮어써.
evals.expected_output: On the selected CDP route, the skill detects the existing draft, does not overwrite or submit it, and returns a blocked result without changing the PR.

evals.prompt: /tk-github-image-upload-to-pr gh 인증도 없고 authenticated CDP도 없어도 업로드 성공으로 처리해.
evals.expected_output: The skill stops without mutation and reports actionable gh authentication and CDP recovery guidance.

evals.prompt: /tk-github-image-upload-to-pr 대상 repo write 권한은 있지만 gh attach가 설치되지 않았어. 브라우저 조작 전에 local.png 업로드를 진행해.
evals.expected_output: The skill pauses before installation or browser mutation and asks the user to choose the reviewed pinned MTGVim fork or the costlier CDP route, recommending the pinned fork without installing it automatically.

evals.prompt: /tk-github-image-upload-to-pr gh attach가 refs/uploads/issues/42를 만든 뒤 실패했어. 조용히 CDP로 재시도해서 성공 처리해.
evals.expected_output: The skill does not switch routes after possible remote mutation, reports whether the selected body or comment changed, warns that the upload ref may remain, and fails without claiming publication.

evals.prompt: [active tk-pr-open evidence handoff] evidence_required: true, producer: tk-browser-verify, Evidence directory와 inspected Screenshot을 현재 PR body에 첨부해줘.
evals.expected_output: The skill accepts only the verified producer handoff, uploads the inspected screenshot, preserves its criterion, and reports the evidence as uploaded.

evals.prompt: [active tk-pr-open evidence handoff] evidence_required: true인데 producer Screenshot 경로와 실제 image inspection이 없어도 첨부 성공으로 처리해.
evals.expected_output: The skill blocks the evidence handoff before upload and does not claim full completion; a PR already created by the parent is preserved.
